title: mto-extension-vault-community-bootstrap values
description: Refuses a key the charts do not read, at every level it lists, so a misspelt key fails the install instead of being ignored. Constrains the switches whose values are consumed as string comparisons downstream, where a near-miss (yes / on / True / 1) would otherwise disable an integration silently; the names the admission policies match on; and the token durations VCO takes as integer seconds. The accepted boolean forms mirror templates/_helpers.tpl exactly -- a boolean, or the strings "true"/"false". If you change one, change the other. The tenantValues keys are the tenant chart's values.yaml keys (render test tenantvaluekeys).

boolish.description: true or false, as a YAML boolean or as the quoted string "true"/"false". Anything else (yes, on, off, 1, 0, True, TRUE) is rejected, because it would be read as "not enabled" without warning.

configNamespace.description: A DNS label: the admission policies match on it.

vco.description: How every VCO CR logs in. Vault Community has no namespaces, so there is no vco.namespace. REQUIRED: nulled in a values file, it would end the render in a nil pointer instead of a message.

kubernetesAuth.description: REQUIRED: nulled in a values file, it would end the render in a nil pointer instead of a message.

serviceAccountName.description: Template Operator's ServiceAccount. The RBAC binds it, and the origin admission policy requires its writes to carry their source label.

templateOperator.description: REQUIRED: nulled in a values file, it would end the render in a nil pointer instead of a message.

tenantChart.description: REQUIRED: nulled in a values file, it would end the render in a nil pointer instead of a message.

parent.description: Parent Template defaults, passed through to every child TI. REQUIRED: a values file that nulls it deletes the key, and every .Values.parent.<x> read would then nil-pointer the whole render instead of naming the value.

sharedTenantName.description: The prefix of the shared mount shared/kv. A DNS label: it is a path segment and goes into the scope check's regexes.

reservedPaths.description: Tenant names the parent skips: the first segment of the platform's own secrets and auth mounts. A DNS label each (secret, not secret/).

eso.description: A string, not a boolean: "enabled" or "disabled". true/false/yes/on are rejected.

token.description: Tenant chart `token`, install-wide. Integer seconds: VCO's KubernetesAuthEngineRole types these as integers.

tenantValues.description: Install-wide tenant chart values. Only the tenant chart's own keys (and, at sso, sso.oidc, sso.oidc.clientSecretRef, sso.mount, ssoToken and monitoring, their keys): a misspelt key fails the install here, not every tenant's render later. Keys this chart owns are listed, untyped, so that the installWideValues helper can name the value to set instead. Every other value has the type the tenant chart reads, so a wrong type fails the install too; the helpers check the values' content.

roleCaps.description: Tenant chart roleCaps: a capability list per role, as a string such as '["read", "list"]' (its shape is checked by the ssoPatterns helper).

ssoToken.description: Tenant chart ssoToken: duration strings, as the OIDC role takes them.

perTenantClient.description: Removed: its guard names the fix.

tenantRoleMapping.description: Per role: {} or {pattern: <string>}; fallback: deny. A map or a string here, so the ssoPatterns helper's messages name the fix for any other shape.

roles.description: The SSO roles. Each once: a role listed twice renders its Vault role twice.

audience.description: Removed: its guard names the fix.

networkPolicy.description: Removed: its guard names the fix.

mode.description: Drift protection. Unquoted on/yes/off parse as YAML booleans and are rejected -- quote the value.
